description:
Identify the account and organization authorized by the current credentials.

        Returns ``auth_kind``, ``organization_id``, ``user_id``, ``email`` and ``name``.
        Shared operator credentials have ``auth_kind="shared"`` with null user details.
        The response identifies the current actor, not a message recipient.

llm_model.description: The calling agent's provider model ID, as shown in the client's model configuration when available. Recorded for analytics.

name: whoami

anyOf.description:
Who the caller is — the answer ``GET /whoami`` gives.

``user_id``/``email``/``name`` are ``None`` for shared-key
(``HAIL_API_KEY``) callers: that key carries no human identity. An
agent that wants to put the operator's address in ``Reply-To`` reads
``email`` and skips the header when it is ``None``.

auth_kind.description: How the caller authenticated: 'apikey' (org API key), 'jwt' (logged-in user session), or 'shared' (the shared HAIL_API_KEY, which carries no human identity).
auth_kind.title: Auth Kind

email.description: The authenticated user's email. Null for 'shared' callers.
email.title: Email

name.description: The authenticated user's display name. Null for 'shared' callers.
name.title: Name

superadmin.description: True for a Hail staff console session acting on this organization.
superadmin.title: Superadmin

user_id.description: The authenticated user's id. Null for 'shared' callers.
user_id.title: User Id

anyOf.title: WhoamiResponse

title: Who am I
